title: Tale of the Third Larrikin Concerning Himself

keywords: tale of the third larrikin concerning himself
full_text:
In the city of Rayy lived a greedy village alderman named Mu'in, who took a plump roasted goose prepared by a poor widow for her orphaned children, claiming it was his 'inspection tribute'.

A quick-witted student named Salim, lodging in the widow's attic, vowed to restore justice with a laugh.
He went to the alderman's banquet hall where Mu'in sat with four pompous friends, boasting of his feast.

Salim entered with an air of urgent gravity, carrying an open parchment:
'Your Honor! A grave grammatical and theological dispute has arisen among the scholars of the academy, and only an alderman of your vast intellect can settle it! The dispute concerns the ancient fable of the Goose that Divided the World.'

Mu'in, flattered beyond measure, puffed up his chest: 'Speak, scholar! I shall divide the goose according to cosmic wisdom!'

Salim carved the roast goose and presented the pieces:
'To you, O Alderman, as the head of the municipality, belongs the head of the goose, that your mind may remain elevated above mundane affairs!
To your two senior counselors belong the two wings, that you may fly together into the clouds of administrative glory!
To your two junior clerks belong the two drumsticks, that they may run swiftly to execute your decrees!
And to me, a poor, humble student representing the hungry orphan children of this district, belongs the humble torso and breast of the goose!'

Before the stunned alderman could comprehend the division, Salim wrapped the roasted bird's body in a clean linen cloth, bowed with profound reverence, and slipped out of the garden gate!

He carried the warm roast goose straight to the widow and her hungry children, who feasted with joyous laughter.
When the alderman realized he was left with only a goose head on his plate, his guests burst into unstoppable laughter at how cleanly his greed had been rebuked by witty justice.
moral: Humorous wit that exposes hypocrisy and restores stolen goods brings joy to the community.
